official_metadata.title: EDM Detection Mode
official_metadata.description: This is a sort of electronic music with a heavy backbeat and thumpin' bass. There is a significant change in theme at around 2 minutes - so if the beginning is a bit boring, you can start there. There is another fun change at around 3:30. If you didn't like the previous bits, just start there! I think you get the picture.
